jobs.title: Head of Product Design - Manager role
jobs.description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

We're seeking an inspiring Head of Product Design - Sports to lead our forward-thinking design team at Super. This strategic role combines vision, hands-on creativity, and leadership to shape the end-to-end customer experience across our sports betting platforms. You will translate company goals and customer needs into compelling design strategies that differentiate our products, foster user engagement, and extend our market reach.

What the role involves

Strategic Leadership & Vision

- Own the design strategy and roadmap for sports betting products, ensuring alignment with overarching business goals

- Translate insights into innovative solutions that enhance user engagement and differentiate our products in a competitive market

Design Execution & Innovation

- Lead the creation of intuitive interfaces, innovative features, and seamless user journeys, employing design thinking and iterative testing

- Partner with product teams to implement solutions that simplify betting, personalise user experiences, and support acquisition and retention goals

- Stay hands-on and involved — sketching wireframes, developing prototypes, and reviewing high-fidelity designs to ensure quality and innovation at every stage

Team Management & Development

- Build, mentor, and motivate a high-calibre design team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and excellence

- Encourage collaboration, diversity of thought, and professional growth among team members

Design Quality & User Engagement

- Establish and uphold best practices, standards, and principles for all design outputs

- Use analytics, user research, and direct feedback to refine interfaces, elevate usability, and improve key metrics like retention and satisfaction

- Track industry trends and integrate emerging methodologies to keep our offerings innovative and relevant

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Research teams, challenging assumptions and advocating for user-centric solutions

- Promote integrated workflows, ensuring seamless execution from concept to delivery

Incorporate Data & Personalisation

- Lead initiatives that embed AI, machine learning, and data-driven insights into the design process, creating highly personalised betting experiences

- Drive ecosystem thinking by considering behaviours across sports, gaming, and social interactions, guiding broader user journey conversations

What we are looking for

- Leadership experience : 12+ years of proven success managing and developing product design teams, particularly in regulated or complex environments such as sports betting, gaming, and/or other sectors such as entertainment or e-commerce

- Mastery of design craft : Demonstrable portfolio showcasing UX, UI, interaction, and visual design impact, along with tangible results that improved user engagement and business metrics

- Strategic and tactical agility : Ability to think big-picture while managing daily deliverables, balancing long-term innovation with immediate product needs

- Exceptional communication skills : Ability to influence and build trust with senior stakeholders, articulate design decisions clearly, and foster collaborative relationships across teams and regions

- Hands-on expertise : Deep familiarity with modern tools like Figma, FullStory, Marvin, and User Testing, including working with design systems, accessibility principles, user research, and inclusive design practices

- Global perspective : Experience designing for diverse markets, understanding regional behaviours, and regulatory landscapes

- Data-driven approach : Comfort navigating analytics platforms, leveraging insights to inform design strategies, and continuously optimising user experiences

- Industry knowledge : Familiarity with sports betting features, regulations, and user behaviours, enabling the creation of compliant yet engaging experiences

What we offer

- Medical / Health Insurance

- Open Annual Leave

- Employee Assistance Programme

- Training & Learning Development

Additional benefits vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process.

About Super

We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

Shaping the Future of Play

Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page:  super.xyz/careers

Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA).

At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance.

jobs.title: Lead TPM
jobs.description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

As a Lead Technical Program Manager , you'll play a vital role in reducing risk and complexity across initiatives that span multiple teams. You'll partner with engineering managers, product managers, and stakeholders to support the delivery of complex change throughout the lifecycle in a product-led organisation.

What the role involves

- Lead large-scale engineering programs from start to finish, partnering with the EM and PM to form a core team, manage feedback loops and scope, and deliver on time.

- Partner with engineering teams, product managers, designers, and stakeholders to align objectives and develop clear execution roadmaps.

- Communicate regular updates to stakeholders and manage expectations around programme progress and decisions.

- Identify and address risks and dependencies across projects before they impact programme goals or timelines.

- Enhance programme management practices, tools, and methods to improve team efficiency and effectiveness.

- Mentor junior programme managers and engineering teams to build a collaborative, high-performing culture.

- Define and track KPIs for programme progress, quality, and timelines, reporting outcomes to senior leadership.

- Work with the VP of Engineering to iterate on how the area operates, covering areas such as delivery tracking, operational excellence, and workforce planning.

What we are looking for

- 10+ years of experience in technical programme management, with a demonstrated track record of delivering multi-team technology programmes at scale.

- Extensive experience partnering directly with software engineering teams, with mastery of project management fundamentals including scope, schedule, budget, quality management, and risk assessment.

- Strong technical acumen, with the ability to create and evaluate system-level technical designs.

- Thorough knowledge of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), product development lifecycle (PDLC), system design, and cloud architecture within a product-led microservice organisation.

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, establish efficient processes, and manage complex release schedules.

- Track record of developing and implementing successful product and technical roadmaps.

- Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing executive leadership and explaining complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

- Strong leadership capabilities, with a proven record of leading and influencing outside of direct line management.

- Knowledge of planning and tracking multiple teams in Jira.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline.

What we offer

- Medical / Health Insurance

- Open Annual Leave

- Employee Assistance Programme

- Training & Learning Development

Additional benefits vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Product Manager Technical
jobs.description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

At Super, Product Manager Technical sit at the intersection of customer needs, business goals, and technical capabilities — driving the vision, execution, and evolution of our products and platform services. This role covers two connected domains: building a unified sports data platform that powers how we ingest, reconcile, and distribute data across our product ecosystem, and leading the decoupling of our offer and trading systems so that pricing, offer creation, and distribution can evolve and scale independently. You will own the product strategy and cross-team delivery for both, representing a foundational shift in how our sportsbook is architected.

What the role involves

- Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for sports data platform and offer decoupling initiatives, aligned with business goals and multi-sport, multi-market expansion.

- Lead the architectural separation of offer and trading systems — identifying coupling points, defining target-state boundaries, and managing phased migration paths.

- Own cross-team programme delivery across multiple engineering teams, managing dependency chains, sequencing, and integration milestones.

- Write clear product requirements and ensure engineering teams have what they need to design and build; review technical designs and provide input.

- Define and track success metrics around platform adoption, data quality, system reliability, and decoupling progress.

- Manage dependencies, risks, and trade-offs across teams — re-sequencing when things shift and escalating early.

- Communicate programme status, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership.

- Partner with operations and trading teams to ensure new capabilities are operationally viable and adopted.

What we are looking for

- 7+ years in technical product management, programme management, or engineering leadership.

- 5+ years of end-to-end product delivery in a technology-led organisation.

- Proven track record leading cross-team programmes with complex dependencies, coordinating delivery across multiple teams with sequenced milestones and integration points.

- Strong understanding of distributed systems, service-oriented architecture, data pipelines, and event-driven systems.

- Experience with system decoupling, platform modernisation, or legacy migration — breaking apart monolithic or tightly coupled systems into independently deployable services.

- Experience with platform or infrastructure product work where customers are other engineering teams and success is measured by adoption, reliability, and operational independence.

- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving decisions with competing priorities and incomplete information.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority.

- Familiarity with agile methodologies, iterative delivery, and backlog management.

Nice to have

- Experience in sports betting, iGaming, or real-time trading platforms.

- Familiarity with entity resolution, master data management, or multi-source data reconciliation.

- Experience with offer management, pricing systems, or trading platform architecture.

- Background in software engineering or a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

What we offer

- Medical / Health Insurance

- Open Annual Leave

- Employee Assistance Programme

- Training & Learning Development

Additional benefits vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process.
